title: Northgate Store and Online Orders: Missed-Appointment Extra for a Long Wait
content:
A customer who waited longer for a Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery receives a larger missed-appointment credit under **Northgate Store and Online Orders**. The wait is counted in calendar days from the order date to the scheduled date the order carries when the credit is worked out, the order date left out and the scheduled date included.

- Fourteen days or more: adds 10 percent.
- Seven to thirteen days: adds 5 percent.
- Fewer than seven days: adds nothing.

**Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical order dated 1 September).** A scheduled date of 15 September is 14 days and adds 10 percent; 14 September is 13 days and adds 5 percent; 8 September is 7 days and adds 5 percent; 7 September is 6 days and adds nothing.
